data.one_liner: Flexible and customizable slideable list item widget for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable slideable list item widget that supports multiple action buttons, adjustable animations, and automatic closing of open items.
use_when: You need a custom slideable list item with action buttons
You want to control animation curves and speeds for sliding items
You need up to 6 action items per slideable element
avoid_when: You require advanced features found in more established packages like flutter_slidable
You need more than 6 action items
strengths: Flexible action item widgets and background colors
Predefined callback to automatically close already slid items
weaknesses: Limited to a maximum of 6 action items
Alternative established packages may offer more features
data.minimal_example:
Slideable(
  resetSlide: resetSlide,
  items: <ActionItems>[
    ActionItems(
      icon: const Icon(Icons.thumb_up, color: Colors.blue),
      onPress: () {},
      backgroudColor: Colors.transparent,
    ),
  ],
  child: Container(child: Text('Slide me')),
)
